title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Gets a New Release Ahead of Season 3
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is currently airing its highly anticipated Season 2, and it’s going to be shorter than expected. The anime continues the journey of Frieren and her party and will conclude in March 2026 with Episode 10.

title: Cancelled MAPPA Anime Sparks Revival Rumors Ahead of Major Milestone
content: MAPPA’s original anime Yuri!!! on Ice , which was released in 2016, became one of the most beloved series, marking the breakthrough year of the animation studio. December 2025 marks the 9th anniversary of the anime reaching its conclusion after teasing a sequel.
